summary: Champion Homes, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting routine board changes: the Board expanded from six to seven directors and elected Michael R. Haack, 53, as an independent director effective August 26, 2026, with a term expiring at the 2027 Annual Meeting. Haack was appointed to the Compensation Committee; Mary Fedewa was designated Chair of the Audit Committee. No arrangements or reportable transactions were noted, and standard director compensation and indemnification agreements apply. This is a routine governance matter, not a special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
